title: kubecon-2026-expense-reminders-scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for KubeCon NA 2026 travel + expenses (Samantha)

High-level reminders:
- Keep all itemized receipts (meals, taxis, parking) — reimbursements require itemized.
- Company card used for booth vendor + hardware only; personal card for meals and miscellaneous. Save CC statement snippet.
- Per diem: $60/day domestic meals (confirm with finance).
- Submit expenses within 30 days post-conference to avoid delays.

Itinerary notes (personal):
- Flight: SFO -> LAS (United UA2346) 2026-02-22 07:10am. Return 2026-02-25 7:40pm. Boarding passes in Wallet + Drive folder.
- Hotel: Mandalay Bay, conf rate (group block) — check-in 2/22, check-out 2/25. Room paid on company card (booking ref: MB-RED-435).
- Booth shift schedule: set by Alex, will confirm final times. Bring: laptop + HDMI adaptor, dongles, backup battery, printed one-pager (100).

Expense checklist (quick):
- [ ] Meals (itemized receipts) — note date, vendor, attendees if business.
- [ ] Taxi / rideshare receipts (save screenshots + CC charged amount).
- [ ] Parking receipts (airport + hotel)
- [ ] Booth vendor invoices (AV, furniture) — get invoice with line items and vendor contact.
- [ ] Hardware purchases (if any) with receipts and reason code.
- [ ] Promo swag receipts (invoice + proof of delivery)
- [ ] On-site printing receipts (if printed at venue)

Vendor contacts (save on phone + Drive):
- AV / Rigging: Pacific Events — contact: Maria Gonzalez, +1-702-555-0198, maria@pacificevents.com. Invoice sent to finance@redwood.ai, ref: KUBE-AV-2026.
- Booth Furniture: BoothWorks Nevada — Raj Patel, +1-702-555-0123, raj@boothworks.com. Delivery window: 2/22 08:00-10:00.
- Swag Vendor: PrintHive — invoice due net30, contact: lily@printhive.co, PO# PR-7782.

Notes for expense submission (Finance):
- Use expense category: Events -> Travel & Conferences -> BoothSupport.
- Attach: itemized receipt + short note linking to Confluence page (KUBE-BOOTH-2026) and JIRA ticket (KUBE-1234).
- Meals with >1 attendee: list names and company (if external).
- Tip: keep digital copies in Drive/expenses/kubecon-2026/ before upload.

Unresolved / follow-up items:
- Confirm per-diem policy with finance (email sent to Priya on 2026-02-03, waiting reply).
- Alex: confirm exact booth headcount schedule and who will cover demo station on Thu afternoon.
- Need final swag count — Lily from marketing to confirm by 2/18.

Quick Slack / links: 
- Slack thread: #events -> KubeCon logistics (thread ts: 1676001234.000200).
- Confluence: confluence.company.com/display/Events/KubeCon+2026+Booth+Plan (linked as confluence:KUBE-BOOTH-2026).
- JIRA epic: KUBE-1234 (booth + logistics).

Expense examples / common gotchas (notes to self):
- If vendor provides a BOL or delivery note instead of invoice, ask for a proper invoice.
- For meals: if reimbursing team coffees/snacks at booth, include a short business justification.
- Some hotel incidentals show as pending on CC — wait for final checkout charge before submitting.

Packing / admin checklist (short):
- [ ] Laptop + charger + USB-C hub + HDMI dongle
- [ ] 100 printed one-pagers (confirm print shop + pickup)
- [ ] Business cards (50)
- [ ] Swag box + extra polybags for shipping
- [ ] Extension cord + power strip (label company)
- [ ] Tape / gaffer / velcro strips

On-site admin flow (day-of):
- Get booth delivery confirmation from BoothWorks at setup. Photograph booth with SKU labels for proof.
- Collect all vendor invoices at teardown and scan/upload to Drive/expenses/kubecon-2026/invoices/.
- Save all credit card receipts and write short memo in expense form explaining any mixed personal/company charges.

Random notes / shorthand (to clean up later):
- Priya (Finance) said they prefer CC statements + receipts bundled in one PDF; will confirm.
- Chris to handle heavy lift on 2/22 morning (truck access). Confirm arrival time with venue.
- Confirm reimbursement SLA for events -> ask for timeline in reply to Priya.

End — transfer these to official expense submission doc after trip. Keep this file as scratchpad (will trim and rename final after expenses filed).
